ih8EMOhntaUWwmyNrAt6hQ.zh: 法屬馬約特島今年至7/26止累計43例確定病例,包括23例本土與19例境外移入(其中18例來自鄰國馬達加斯加、1例為法國)。個案以男性為主(70%),且近8成具高風險性行為史。目前疫情已波及10個(10/17)市鎮,以首府馬穆楚(13例)最為嚴峻,當局呼籲加強監測與接觸者追蹤。
ih8EMOhntaUWwmyNrAt6hQ.en: Mayotte, a French overseas territory, has cumulatively reported 43 confirmed cases this year as of 26 July: 23 local and 19 imported (18 from neighbouring Madagascar and 1 from mainland France). Cases are mainly male (70%), and nearly 80% had a history of high-risk sexual behaviour. The outbreak has spread to 10 of 17 communes; the capital, Mamoudzou, is the most affected, with 13 cases. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance and contact tracing.

XD3Wq_UR_ruoU6Q54EHHFQ.zh: 印度賈坎德州東新奔縣爆發疫情,自6/24-7/2累計報告150例腦性瘧疾(cerebral malaria)病例,其中4例兒童死亡,致死率約2.7%,6/30單日檢出26例腦性瘧疾病例,顯示於當地持續傳播。賈坎德州為該國惡性瘧原蟲(P. falciparum)感染病例數較多地區之一。 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至6/21累計報告244例確定病例,其中已知161例為境外移入(95.6%來自葛摩)、25例為本土病例,今年累計244例病例數已高於去年全年111例,且疫情已於希龍吉以外地區傳播,55%病例為15-44歲年齡層族群,目前檢出致病原為惡性瘧原蟲。
XD3Wq_UR_ruoU6Q54EHHFQ.en: In East Singhbhum district, Jharkhand State, India, an outbreak has reported 150 cerebral malaria cases cumulatively from 24 June to 2 July, including 4 child deaths, a fatality ratio of about 2.7%. On 30 June alone, 26 cerebral malaria cases were detected, indicating ongoing local transmission. Jharkhand is one of the states in India with a high number of Plasmodium falciparum infections. In Mayotte, France, cases are rising. As of 21 June this year, 244 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively; of these, 161 were known imported cases (95.6% from Comoros) and 25 were local cases. The 244 cases reported this year already exceed last year's full-year total of 111. The outbreak has spread beyond Chirongui, and 55% of cases are aged 15 to 44 years. The pathogen detected is Plasmodium falciparum.

_XEay6oXnBUZ8j19p1Q_tg.zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,今年截至5月下旬累計報告197例病例,於5月份疫情傳播呈現加速趨勢,主要分布於南部地區(希龍吉),美國CDC近期提升法屬馬約特島疫情旅遊警示至第2級。 葉門塔伊茲省疫情上升,今年迄今累計報告逾22,000例病例,較往年明顯增加,該國約64%人口面臨感染風險,尤其是孕婦及5歲以下兒童為最脆弱族群。
_XEay6oXnBUZ8j19p1Q_tg.en: Malaria in Mayotte is rising: 197 cases had been reported cumulatively this year as of late May, and transmission accelerated in May, mainly in the southern region (Chirongui). The US CDC recently raised its travel alert for the Mayotte outbreak to Level 2. In Yemen's Taiz Governorate, malaria is rising: more than 22,000 cases have been reported so far this year, markedly higher than in previous years. About 64% of the country's population is at risk of infection, with pregnant women and children under 5 the most vulnerable.

9xrQrmVc7iMTSUnCoJYr5A.zh: 法屬馬約特島近1週(4/27-5/3)報告32例病例,為今年單週最高病例數,主要分布於南部希龍吉(20例),其中17例疑為本土病例,該島已多年無本土病例。今年截至5/12當地累計報告156例確診病例,惡性瘧原蟲為主要瘧原蟲。
9xrQrmVc7iMTSUnCoJYr5A.en: In the most recent week (27 April–3 May), Mayotte reported 32 cases, the highest weekly number this year, mainly in the southern Chirongui area (20 cases). Of these, 17 cases are suspected to be locally acquired; the island had no local cases for many years. As of 12 May this year, 156 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, with Plasmodium falciparum the main species.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至去(2025)年12/31累計143國/地區報告17萬7千餘例確診病例,其中,至少477例死亡;去年累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中215例死亡。WHO 去年12月共計42國家/地區報告1,169 例新增確診病例,其中 6例死亡,69%來自非洲地區,相較11月,全球各區疫情皆呈下降趨勢,捷克、以色列、馬達加斯加、泊爾及法屬馬約特島通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2025/12/7-2026/1/18)共計15 國通報871例確診病例,5例死亡,其中,以剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、馬達加斯加、賴比瑞亞、肯亞及迦納為高。馬達加斯加自去年12月起爆發Ib型社區傳播,首例為近期無旅遊史個案,已迅速擴散至全國。 非洲以外地區,法國、義大利及西班牙持續出現Ib型社區傳播;捷克通報1例病例仍在調查中。 WHO發布《Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus》,彙整現有證據與專家意見,說明執行 MPXV 基因體監測的之關鍵考量,以支持病原體基因體學於公共衛生監測及應變之應用。WHO 1/22
nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情持續,近1週(9/28-10/4)新增3,181例病例,主要分布於江門市2,480例,其次為佛山市、廣州市及肇慶市分別新增100餘例,無報告重症及死亡病例,江門市近期疫情仍處高點波動,由於假期人潮流動、氣候等因素致疫情傳播風險持續增加,當地已啟動突發公共衛生事件三級響應,全力展開防控工作。 全球疫情持續,今年截至9/30累計40國報告445,271例病例及155例死亡,部分國家/地區於今年發生疫情,包括近幾年病例數並不多之國家/地區。全球病例分布以美洲區最多,其中,以巴西疫情最為嚴峻;歐洲區之法國及義大利報告本土病例,法國今年疫情上升與法屬留旺島及印度洋地區疫情有關,法屬留旺島/馬約特島疫情已下降;東南亞區以印度病例數為多,孟加拉、泰國及斯里蘭卡亦報告病例;西太平洋區之中國廣東省截至9/27累計16,452例確診病例,分布於21城市,以佛山市10,032例及江門市5,209例為多,為該國有紀錄以來最大規模疫情,另廣西壯族自治區於9/1-21報告297例,福建省報告124例,其他省份如湖南省、四川省、海南省亦報告病例;非洲區以模里西斯共和國病例數為多;東地中海區之巴基斯坦及索馬利亞亦報告病例。WHO建議加強監測、實驗室及醫療保健能力、病媒監控,以降低疾病進一步傳播風險。
CZ_49AJRgiEeT3xPTFR6Vw.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues. In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Because of holiday population movement, weather and other factors, transmission risk continues to increase. The area has launched a Level III public health emergency response and is fully carrying out prevention and control work. Globally, the outbreak continues: as of 30 September this year, 40 countries had reported 445,271 cases and 155 deaths cumulatively. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. In Europe, France and Italy reported locally acquired cases. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. In Africa, Mauritius has the most cases. In the Eastern Mediterranean, Pakistan and Somalia also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.zh: 全球今年迄今累計報告約220,000例病例及80例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西141,436例及阿根廷2,521例為多,亞洲之印度、斯里蘭卡及巴基斯坦等國報告逾33,000例,非洲塞內加爾亦有報告病例,另法屬留旺島/馬約特島分別報告逾51,000例及560例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境愈來愈利於病媒蚊活動,當地疾病傳播風險增加。
TEEthy_-_aneVY0fNVJGuA.en: Globally this year, about 220,000 cases and 80 deaths have been reported cumulatively, in the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as in the French overseas territories of Réunion and Mayotte. The Americas have the most cases, with Brazil reporting 141,436 and Argentina 2,521. Asian countries including India, Sri Lanka and Pakistan have reported more than 33,000 cases. Senegal in Africa has also reported cases. Réunion and Mayotte have reported more than 51,000 and 560 cases, respectively. ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is increasingly favorable for vector mosquito activity, and the risk of local transmission is increasing.

X760MVRe0Hu-xblS7bFCaw.zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情更新,今年第21週報告204例病例,較前1週144例上升42%,自第10週起住院病例數持續上升,今年迄今累計560例,病例主要分布於該島省會馬穆楚,以15-64歲個案為多,佔所有病例近80%。 巴西疫情更新,今年1-5月累計報告15萬8,400餘例病例,病例主要分布於該國西部馬托羅索州。
X760MVRe0Hu-xblS7bFCaw.en: Mayotte (France) update: 204 cases were reported in week 21 this year, up 42% from 144 cases the previous week. Hospitalizations have risen continuously since week 10, with 560 cases reported year to date. Cases are concentrated in the island's capital, Mamoudzou, and people aged 15 to 64 account for nearly 80% of all cases. Brazil update: from January to May this year, more than 158,400 cases have been reported, mainly in Mato Grosso State in the west of the country.

ZTW5uRHzYq7nGAxZZ0uYzQ.zh: 法屬馬約特島疫情上升,自3/5於該島東北部發現首例輸入病例後,截至5/4累計報告116例病例,其中57例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,為自2005-06年疫情以來首次報告本土傳播病例,另法屬留旺島近期亦爆發大規模疫情,WHO預期印度洋島嶼將進一步爆發疫情。
ZTW5uRHzYq7nGAxZZ0uYzQ.en: Mayotte (France): the outbreak is rising. After the first imported case was detected in the northeast of the island on 5 March, 116 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 4 May, of which 57 were locally acquired, and 1 patient is hospitalized. No deaths have been recorded. This is the first reported locally acquired case since the outbreak of 2005–06. Meanwhile, Réunion (France) has recently experienced a large outbreak, and WHO expects further outbreaks on Indian Ocean islands.

dTfDquY-q-JMUcFG81OWbQ.zh: 法屬留旺島疫情更新,近1週報告4,304例本土病例,今年迄今累計39,532例病例,自第11週迄今已報告47例重症,重症個案主要為老年族群及嬰兒。 法屬馬約特島疫情更新,今年迄今累計報告55例病例,其中17例為本土病例,1例住院治療,迄無死亡病例,該國鄰近之法屬留旺島近期疫情亦為嚴峻。
dTfDquY-q-JMUcFG81OWbQ.en: Réunion update: the outbreak is ongoing. In the most recent week, 4,304 locally acquired cases were reported, and so far this year 39,532 cases have been reported cumulatively. Since week 11, 47 severe cases have been reported, mainly among older people and infants. Mayotte update: 55 cases have been reported cumulatively this year, of which 17 were locally acquired; 1 patient is hospitalized and there have been no deaths so far. The recent outbreak on neighboring Réunion is also severe.

WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.zh: 全球今年截至3月累計14國/地區報告約80,000例病例及46例死亡,分布於美/非/亞洲、法屬留旺島及馬約特島,其中,美洲病例數最多,以巴西71,578例(44例死亡)及阿根廷1,550例為多,亞洲巴基斯坦報告393例,非洲塞內加爾報告2例,另法屬留旺島報告逾13,000例(2例死亡),法屬馬約特島報告1例,ECDC評估歐洲目前環境仍不利於病媒蚊活動,每年疫情多發生於6 -11月。
WBvuna4xQ0bkW8a3mcIinA.en: As of March this year, 14 countries and regions globally have reported about 80,000 cases and 46 deaths cumulatively, distributed across the Americas, Africa and Asia, as well as Réunion and Mayotte (France). The Americas have the most cases, led by Brazil with 71,578 cases (44 deaths) and Argentina with 1,550. In Asia, Pakistan reported 393 cases; in Africa, Senegal reported 2 cases. Réunion (France) reported more than 13,000 cases (2 deaths), and Mayotte (France) reported 1 case. The ECDC assesses that the environment in Europe is still unfavourable for vector mosquito activity, and outbreaks in Europe each year mostly occur from June to November.
